dedupe_keys.name: taxas teifa oper e teip oper

description: ONS publishes TEIFa_Oper and TEIP_Oper rates for centrally dispatched Type I and Type II-A plants over the latest sixty months. The dictionary supplies plant identifier, reference month, rate name, calculation time and version. Rate values are bounded between zero and one. These operational rates support plant-availability and reliability studies. They differ from the existing TEIFa/TEIP product and the operating-hour inputs. Later calculation versions can revise earlier values. Coverage is centrally dispatched generating plants in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS TEIFa/TEIP rates provide the separately catalogued unavailability product.
